item.title: Follow joy
item.description: (This is a second article from my Life Design Series. You can find the first article here: Start where you are.) Doing work you enjoy is a crucial part of designing a good life. In this article, I’ll show you how to find things you enjoy so you can start building your work-life around them. Do work you enjoy I’m just gonna say it: I suck at doing things I don’t enjoy.
